summary.text: A Chinese version of Executive Board resolution EB77.R12 (January 1986) on WHO activities against AIDS, describing AIDS and LAV/HTLV-III infection as a growing public health problem with no drug or vaccine yet available. The Board endorses the Director-General's report and urges Member States to stay vigilant, adopt prevention and control strategies, and share information openly with WHO and each other.

summary.text: Continues the Chinese text of resolution EB77.R12, asking WHO to expand its AIDS programme by sharing information, issuing guidelines, assessing commercial antibody test kits, helping national control programmes, advising on safe blood, and promoting research on drugs and vaccines. It also asks the Director-General to raise extrabudgetary funds for surveillance, laboratory, clinical and control programmes.
